title: Full Stack Developer

nodes.title: Semantic Web Foundations & Modern CSS
nodes.subtitle: HTML5 structure, accessibility (a11y), CSS Box Model, Flexbox and Grid layouts
learning_objectives: Structure accessible semantic HTML markup
Build responsive layouts using CSS Flexbox and Grid
feynman_prompts: Why is semantic HTML critical for assistive technologies and search engine indexing?
key_misconceptions: Using non-semantic <div> elements for all layout and interaction buttons

nodes.title: Modern JavaScript & Asynchronous Foundations
nodes.subtitle: ES6+ syntax, closures, event loop, Promises, async/await, Fetch API
learning_objectives: Write clean asynchronous code using Promises and async/await
Handle network requests and responses using the native Fetch API
feynman_prompts: How does the JavaScript event loop handle non-blocking asynchronous I/O?
key_misconceptions: Mutating shared object state unexpectedly across asynchronous functions

nodes.title: Full-Stack TypeScript Development
nodes.subtitle: Type system, interfaces, generics, shared types between client and server
learning_objectives: Define shared data contracts (DTOs) used by both frontend and backend
Enforce strict type checking to eliminate runtime null/undefined crashes
feynman_prompts: What are the advantages of end-to-end type safety across the frontend and backend?
key_misconceptions: Using 'any' as a quick bypass for TypeScript compiler errors

nodes.title: React Component & State Architecture
nodes.subtitle: JSX, component decomposition, useState, useEffect, custom hooks
learning_objectives: Build modular component hierarchies following unidirectional data flow
Manage component state and side effects with custom hooks
feynman_prompts: Why must React state updates be treated as immutable?
key_misconceptions: Directly mutating state variables instead of using setter functions

nodes.title: Backend API Development with Node / Python
nodes.subtitle: Server architecture, Express/FastAPI, routing, request validation, middleware
learning_objectives: Implement structured REST API routes with request validation middleware
Handle errors gracefully and return standardized HTTP error responses
feynman_prompts: Why should API route controllers delegate business logic to separate service layers?
key_misconceptions: Putting all database queries and business logic inside the route handler

nodes.title: Relational Database Design & SQL
nodes.subtitle: PostgreSQL schema design, primary/foreign keys, joins, normalization, transactions
learning_objectives: Design normalized relational database schemas with data integrity rules
Execute complex SQL queries with joins, groupings, and transactions
feynman_prompts: Explain the difference between primary keys, foreign keys, and unique indexes.
key_misconceptions: Storing unstructured JSON strings in relational tables where foreign keys should be used

nodes.title: ORMs & Schema Migrations
nodes.subtitle: Prisma / SQLAlchemy, data modeling, versioned migrations, query optimization
learning_objectives: Define application data models and execute automated schema migrations
Detect and resolve N+1 query performance issues using eager loading
feynman_prompts: What is the N+1 query problem and how does eager loading prevent it?
key_misconceptions: Running destructive schema migrations directly against production databases without testing

nodes.title: Full-Stack Authentication & Session Management
nodes.subtitle: JWT tokens, HTTP-only secure cookies, password hashing with bcrypt, CSRF protection
learning_objectives: Implement secure user authentication using HTTP-only cookies and JWTs
Hash user passwords securely using bcrypt with work factors
feynman_prompts: Why are HTTP-only cookies safer for storing auth tokens than browser localStorage?
key_misconceptions: Storing sensitive auth tokens in localStorage where they are vulnerable to XSS attacks

nodes.title: Client Data Fetching & Caching with TanStack Query
nodes.subtitle: Server cache synchronization, optimistic updates, query invalidation, error handling
learning_objectives: Synchronize client UI with remote server data using declarative query hooks
Implement optimistic updates to make UI feel instant during mutations
feynman_prompts: Why is it an anti-pattern to copy server response data into local client state stores?
key_misconceptions: Refetching data manually using useEffect on every render

nodes.title: Full-Stack Web Frameworks: Next.js App Router
nodes.subtitle: Server Components, Client Components, SSR, SSG, Server Actions, route handlers
learning_objectives: Leverage React Server Components (RSC) to reduce client JavaScript bundle sizes
Build fullstack features using Server Actions with automatic revalidation
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between a Server Component and a Client Component in Next.js?
key_misconceptions: Marking every component with 'use client' and losing the benefits of server rendering

nodes.title: Caching & Performance with Redis
nodes.subtitle: In-memory caching, Cache-Aside pattern, session stores, rate limiting
learning_objectives: Accelerate slow database queries by implementing Cache-Aside with Redis
Protect backend API endpoints against abuse using Redis rate limiters
feynman_prompts: Explain how the Cache-Aside pattern handles cache misses and cache updates.
key_misconceptions: Caching data infinitely without setting appropriate Time-To-Live (TTL) expirations

nodes.title: Docker Containerization for Full-Stack Apps
nodes.subtitle: Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, docker-compose for app + db + redis
learning_objectives: Containerize frontend and backend applications using multi-stage Dockerfiles
Orchestrate full local development environments with Docker Compose
feynman_prompts: Why are multi-stage Docker builds recommended for production web applications?
key_misconceptions: Including local node_modules or secret .env files inside Docker images

nodes.title: Full-Stack Automated Testing
nodes.subtitle: Vitest/Jest for unit tests, React Testing Library, API integration tests, Playwright E2E
learning_objectives: Write comprehensive unit tests for business logic and component behavior
Automate end-to-end user workflows using Playwright cross-browser tests
feynman_prompts: Why does testing user behavior by accessible role create more durable tests than testing implementation details?
key_misconceptions: Testing trivial implementation details like internal state variable names

nodes.title: Full-Stack Web Security: OWASP Top 10
nodes.subtitle: XSS sanitization, SQL injection prevention, CORS, Content Security Policy, rate limiting
learning_objectives: Sanitize user input and enforce strict Content Security Policy headers
Prevent injection vulnerabilities and validate cross-origin resource sharing
feynman_prompts: What is Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and how does output encoding prevent it?
key_misconceptions: Assuming frontend validation is sufficient to prevent malicious database attacks

nodes.title: CI/CD & Cloud Deployment Pipelines
nodes.subtitle: GitHub Actions, automated test workflows, Vercel/Render/AWS deployment, zero-downtime deploys
learning_objectives: Automate build and test pipelines using GitHub Actions workflows
Deploy fullstack applications to cloud platforms with environment configurations
feynman_prompts: Why is continuous integration (CI) essential for maintaining code quality in teams?
key_misconceptions: Deploying unverified code directly to production without automated test verification

nodes.title: Observability, Structured Logging & Error Tracking
nodes.subtitle: Structured JSON logging, Sentry error monitoring, health checks, performance metrics
learning_objectives: Capture and trace production runtime errors with context using Sentry
Instrument API response latency metrics and liveness health checks
feynman_prompts: Why are correlation IDs necessary when tracing errors across client and server logs?
key_misconceptions: Using console.log() statements in production code without structured context

nodes.title: GraphQL APIs & Schema Federation
nodes.subtitle: GraphQL schemas, queries, mutations, resolvers, DataLoader for N+1 batching
learning_objectives: Design GraphQL APIs providing precise client data fetching without overfetching
Prevent N+1 database queries using DataLoader batching
feynman_prompts: How does GraphQL DataLoader batch multiple field resolver queries into a single database SQL query?
key_misconceptions: Permitting arbitrary unbounded nested GraphQL queries in production without query complexity limits

nodes.title: Real-Time Push & WebSocket Notifications
nodes.subtitle: WebSockets, Socket.io, pub/sub presence channels, reconnection handling
learning_objectives: Implement live chat and collaborative updates using WebSockets
Handle connection drops gracefully with reconnection backoff
feynman_prompts: When should you choose WebSockets over Server-Sent Events for client notifications?
key_misconceptions: Holding open un-authenticated WebSocket connections indefinitely

nodes.title: System Design & Distributed Data Patterns
nodes.subtitle: Horizontal scaling, read replicas, database sharding, CAP theorem, CDN edge caching
learning_objectives: Design high-availability systems with read-replica database routing
Evaluate CAP theorem trade-offs for distributed web applications
feynman_prompts: Why is asynchronous read-replica replication subject to replication lag?
key_misconceptions: Attempting to shard databases prematurely before vertical and index optimizations

nodes.title: Cloud Object Storage & CDN Asset Delivery
nodes.subtitle: AWS S3 / Cloudflare R2, presigned upload URLs, CDN caching, image optimization
learning_objectives: Upload large user files directly to S3 using secure presigned URLs
Distribute static assets and optimized images via CDN edge caches
feynman_prompts: Why should large file uploads bypass backend web servers using presigned cloud URLs?
key_misconceptions: Buffering 500MB file uploads in backend server memory before writing to disk

description: Master Full Stack Developer with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 20 core and advanced milestones.
